userStories.notes: RevolverAnimation component renders a 6-chamber SVG cylinder that rotates 720deg over 600ms (350ms condensed for non-triggering players), followed by a 220ms radial flash (destructive red on hit, success green on blank), then a fade-in result label. prefers-reduced-motion shrinks the animation to just the flash + label (spinMs=0). Board.tsx triggers the animation off challengeResult (triggerKey=shooterId:chamberIndex so restarts work). Timing math extracted into revolverTiming.ts so it can be unit-tested under node env.
